mapper.sql: tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND id=#{query.id} AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_gate SET deleted=1,version=version+1,updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proj_project_milestone WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_milestone SET deleted=1,version=version+1,updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE proj_project_task SET deleted=1,version=version+1,updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE AND status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGN','PENDING_START') AND actual_start_time IS NULL

UPDATE proj_project_stage SET deleted=1,version=version+1,updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE AND status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_task t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND t.stage_code=proj_project_stage.stage_code AND t.deleted=0 AND (t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL OR t.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_ACCEPT','DONE','CLOSED')))

UPDATE proj_project_task_execution_contract SET effective_to=#{query.closedAt},version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_task_id=#{query.nodeInstanceId} AND id=#{query.contractId} AND current_marker=1 AND effective_to IS NULL AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_task t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND t.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND t.id=#{query.nodeInstanceId})

UPDATE proj_project_stage_execution_contract SET effective_to=#{query.closedAt},version=version+1, updater=#{query.updater},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId} AND stage_id=#{query.nodeInstanceId} AND id=#{query.contractId} AND effective_to IS NULL AND version=#{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM proj_task_tree_path WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND project_id=#{query.projectId}
